Air India.note: Economy Value/Classic/Flex: Value gets 1x23kg US/Canada->India (India-origin pages still say 2x23 for all economy), Classic/Flex 2x23; extra_bag_usd is an estimated Value->Classic upgrade, airport excess piece is USD 240.

Emirates.note: Google shows '2 free checked bags' on the cheapest fare both ways on this route. Economy Special elsewhere is 1x23kg; an extra piece South Asia-Americas is $250 at the airport, about $212 in advance.

Qatar Airways.note: Economy Lite includes 1x23kg; Classic and higher 2x23kg to/from the Americas. Extra piece about $200 online, $255 at the airport.

Etihad.note: Cheapest fare (Basic) has no checked bag (Google confirms on BOM-BOS and BOS-BOM). Extra bag $260 at the airport from 23 Apr 2026; buying online in advance is cheaper but the exact price is unverified, so $200 is used. Value and higher fares include 2x23kg to/from the USA.

Turkish Airlines.note: USA piece concept is 1x23kg or 2x23kg 'depending on route' (EcoFly/ExtraFly/PrimeFly); India-US is often 2x23 but unconfirmed, so EcoFly is set conservatively to 1; extra_bag_usd estimated (EcoFly->ExtraFly upgrade or prepaid piece).

Lufthansa.note: Google shows '1st checked bag per passenger free' on the cheapest BOS-BOM fare. No economy fare includes 2 bags; the discounted 2nd bag on USA routes is $90 (if it does not apply, about $200).

SWISS.note: Economy Light has no checked bag (1st bag $90); other fares 1x23kg; a further bag about $190-210 online. No India-USA 2-bag rule.

Austrian.note: Long-haul: Economy Light 0 bags (first bag at reduced prepaid rate), Classic/Flex 1x23kg, discounted 2nd piece on some intercontinental routes; fee estimated from Lufthansa Group rates.

British Airways.note: Basic is hand baggage only; Standard and Flex 1x23kg; no India 2-bag rule. Extra bag prices are from third-party sites (BA only has a calculator).

Virgin Atlantic.note: Economy Light has no checked bag: 1st bag $75, 2nd $100. Classic and Delight include 2x23kg on USA-India.

Air France.note: Economy Light has no checked bag, Standard/Flex 1x23kg; extra bags US/Canada to 'rest of world' about $120 each (same table as KLM).

KLM.note: Google shows '2 free checked bags per passenger' on the cheapest BOS-BOM fare (sold with Delta). KLM's own page says Light 0 / Standard 1 with extra bags $120 each to 'rest of world', so confirm at booking.

United.note: Basic Economy: 1st bag $90, 2nd $240; Economy includes 1 (2nd $240). From a third-party reading of United's calculator.

American.note: India: 1st bag free in Basic (tickets issued from 23 Apr 2026) and Main Cabin; 2nd bag $100; Main Plus includes 2.

Delta.note: India: 1st bag free on Main Basic and Main Classic, 2nd bag $100 (Delta shows fees only in a calculator; secondary sources).

Aer Lingus.note: Transatlantic Saver has no checked bag, Smart/Flex 1x23kg; no own India service so it only appears on combined itineraries; extra_bag_usd estimated (online bag ~EUR 60-75).

Saudia.note: Guest Saver/Basic/Semi Flex/Flex: Saver is hand-baggage only, Basic and up 1x23kg to North America per Saudia's table (older pages said 2x23kg); extra_bag_usd estimated.

Gulf Air.note: USA routes use the piece concept: Economy Light 1x23kg, Smart/Flex 2x23kg per secondary sources (Gulf Air says allowance depends on fare family); extra_bag_usd estimated.

Kuwait Airways.note: Economy 2x23kg; Economy Saver is 1x32kg except to/from New York (2 pieces) and the Zero Bag fare excludes JFK, so India-New York economy keeps 2x23kg.

Oman Air.note: Super Saver has no checked bag, Comfort/Flex include bags; Oman Air's India-North America FAQ lists economy 1x23kg with extra piece USD 200; no own US flights (codeshare only); extra_bag_usd estimated.

IndiGo.note: No own US service; long-haul (AMS/MAN) uses weight concept, 30kg on base fares, which is short of 2x23kg, and US trips via KLM/Delta/Virgin codeshares may follow partner rules; extra_bag_usd estimated.

Air Canada.note: Tickets bought on/after 14 May 2026 (Canada/US-Asia): Economy Basic 1st bag USD 90 + 2nd USD 120, Standard/Flex 1st free + 2nd USD 120; extra_bag_usd 105 is the Basic per-piece average (use 120 for Standard).

Finnair.note: Economy Light 0 bags, Classic/Flex 1x23kg on both Asia and North America routes; extra_bag_usd estimated (long-haul extra bag ~EUR 80-100).

Iberia.note: Long-haul Basic has no checked bag, Optima/Comfort 1x23kg; no own India service; extra_bag_usd estimated (2nd long-haul bag ~USD 80-100).

EgyptAir.note: Economy allowance is 'according to fare rules' (23kg pieces); North America is usually 2x23kg but some promo/saver fares may drop to 1 piece; extra_bag_usd estimated.

Ethiopian.note: Economy 2x23kg (India FAQ); a USA-India promo gives 3x23kg for travel through 30 Nov 2026; extra_bag_usd estimated.
